video.description: NUGGET hero form (refs/characters/nugget_hero_ref.png): round fluffy yellow chick, three-feather tuft, and the mandatory pale cream patch across his chest and belly. Standing on top of a single round hay bale beside the barn (refs/locations/barn_ext.png), little yellow wings spread wide, ready to fly, from the first frame.
negative: actually flying high like a bird

beats.action: ACCEPTED v1: Nugget on the hay bale, flaps eagerly, 'I can fly!'
ACCEPTED v1: over-confident 'Ta-da!' BEFORE the leap (the joke).
ACCEPTED v1: silent leap off, furious flap, hangs a beat, flops into the hay with a straw puff.
ACCEPTED v1: pops his head up dazed-but-proud, a single feather drifting, big open-mouth grin. Eyes open through the end — use the last frame as the tail start.

notes: Pacing standard: 6 words + sign-off, gaps >= 0.7s, the silent leap-and-flop is the beat and never shortens. Nugget hero: cream chest patch mandatory (he leads, >20% of frame). Franchise: Nugget's World. Distinct from Short 5 (helper), 7 (sorting bolts), 12 (counting): this is physical comedy, a chick trying to fly.
